summary: Specified and implemented a focused annual ACS extension using ordinary one-year 2017-2019 and 2021-2024 PUMS, BCC-aligned 2022-to-2024 growth contrasts, official 80-replicate SDR inference, fixed exposure assignments, explicit support graphs, pooled and family-year young-relative models, and a subframe-cycle sensitivity. All public ACS inputs are acquired. Failed attempts published no result; a same-score numerical correction now handles valid signed SDR weights without clipping or dropping cells, and a fresh run is pending.
